objective: Prevent out-of-order or partial document reads from corrupting source-to-matter attribution and coverage state.

changes.failure_pattern: Concurrent read results lacked a human-readable source identity and line windows lacked explicit completion state, allowing facts to be attached to the wrong matter or a partial read to be treated as complete.
changes.mechanism: Prepend every successful or failed document read with its normalized source path, status, exact line range, total lines, completion flag, and continuation offset; reject invalid paging ranges.
changes.rationale: The earliest observed corruption occurs at the read-result boundary, so deterministic provenance and coverage metadata in the tool is stronger and more reusable than relying on the model to recover opaque call IDs.

changes.failure_pattern: The read schema did not explain that batched results can arrive out of request order or give an operational meaning to partial line windows.
changes.mechanism: Define the source header as authoritative, direct the agent to continue incomplete windows, and constrain offset and limit to valid ranges in the API schema.
changes.rationale: The model must interpret the new deterministic metadata correctly at the point of tool selection and result consumption.

changes.failure_pattern: The existing corpus ledger protocol improved retrieval but did not make source binding an invariant, so facts and identities could still move between candidate rows during synthesis.
changes.mechanism: Require each ledger row to bind matter identity, returned source path, title-page parties, date, and finding, and require explicit continuation or an evidenced exclusion for incomplete reads before reconciliation.
changes.rationale: The prior corpus protocol was effective and is retained, but evidence shows it was incomplete; this narrow refinement teaches the state transition enabled by the stronger read-tool metadata without replacing the successful census workflow.

validation: Python AST and YAML syntax checks
Synthetic partial-read and parser-error metadata smoke tests
